intro.text: A high-ranking vizier in the court of Prime Aqasix Yanagawn the First of Azir.
The senior vizier of Azir and Prime Yanagawn's closest advisor, who comes to lead the meetings of Dalinar's coalition of monarchs.

items.text: Noura passed the tests to become a vizier at only twelve, giving her seniority over much older viziers. She has served in Azimir, the capital of Azir, ever since.

Noura was in the Bronze Palace during a failed robbery by Huqin's crew. When a man called Darkness came to arrest the young thief Lift, Noura checked his papers and was shocked that a child thief faced death. She pushed a table into one of his men, letting Lift escape.

Following Darkness, the viziers found the thief Gawx dying with his throat slit, then saw him seemingly brought back to life. Noura led a vote on the spot to make him the new Prime Aqasix, believing he could survive the Assassin in White.
She remained lead vizier after Yanagawn was crowned, and missed Lift while she was away in Yeddaw.

Noura met Dalinar Kholin in Azimir after he had shown Yanagawn his visions. Openly distrustful of the Alethi, she was surprised when he answered with essays by Fen, Navani and Jasnah rather than threats. Walking him through the city, she told him how Azir's parshmen had demanded reparations before leaving.

At the first meeting of monarchs in Urithiru, Noura advised Yanagawn in whispers, questioning whether the Radiants' powers and the Oathgates were safe. She concluded a coalition made sense, and Yanagawn offered troops for Jah Keved.
In Thaylen City, as damaging revelations threw the coalition into chaos, Noura asked Dalinar outright whether Odium had appeared in his visions, and he admitted it.
Distrustful of Surgebinders and of Dalinar, she took the Azish delegation home by ship, refusing the Oathgate. When Yanagawn wanted to turn back, she reminded him that the emperor did not rule alone.

After the Battle of Thaylen Field Noura admitted she had been wrong about Dalinar. She attended Shallan and Adolin's wedding with gifts from Yanagawn and Lift, and Azir rejoined the meetings of monarchs.

Over the following year Noura came to lead the coalition's meetings. She had Dalinar present his plan to attack Emul, which all agreed to, and after Taravangian's betrayal she agreed that Dalinar had handled it well.

Meeting Dalinar and Jasnah in the Prime's tent, Noura conceded that Yanagawn had judged Jasnah better than she had, and argued for retaking Urithiru. Doubtful of Dalinar's idea of recruiting the Herald Ishar, she suggested sending Radiants to bring Ishar to the camp instead.

appearance.text: She has a round face, dark eyes and long greying hair in a tight side braid, and wears a hat and long layered robes of bright Azish patterns that mark rank.

personality.text: Intelligent and literate, she writes poetry in elegant script, speaks Alethi and admires Jasnah Kholin's essays.
Educated and logical, she values law and bureaucracy and is fiercely loyal to Azir and the Prime, yet will bend the law to do what is right. Frank and calm, she is not easily intimidated.
